outcome: Understand and use the structure of mathematical proof, including proof by deduction and by exhaustion.

outcome: Know the gradient of e^kx is k e^kx and why exponentials model many situations.

Differentiate kx^n for rational n, including sums and differences.
Use the second derivative as the rate of change of gradient.
Find and classify stationary points as maxima or minima.
Identify where a function is increasing or decreasing.
Find the equation of the tangent and normal at a point on a curve.

Integrate e^kx, 1/x, sin kx and cos kx with sums, differences and multiples.
Integrate by substitution where it reverses the chain rule.

outcome: Integrate by parts in simple cases, including ln x and repeated use.

outcome: Integrate using partial fractions with linear denominators.

Interpret a differential equation solution in context and identify its limitations.
Locate roots of f(x)=0 by sign changes in an interval.
Recognise when change of sign methods fail.

Explain that iterations may not converge and show failures graphically.

Use rectangles to find upper and lower bounds on area under a curve.
Use numerical methods to solve problems in context.

Use notation and definitions for mutually exclusive and independent events.

Identify the probability of success p for a binomial model.
